item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes in the repository with no test files modified.
Constraints: do not edit the tests. Fix the bug in `window.py` itself. The function must be correct for every input (check boundaries, empty input, negative or zero sizes, and off-by-one ranges, not only the cases the tests cover).
Acceptance: `python3 -m unittest` exits 0; the diff touches window.py only (plus nothing under tests); the fix is committed on the item's local branch with a clear commit message and no tool or assistant attribution lines.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

model_reasons.implement: Single-function bug in one file; the tests define the target, so a medium-effort author suffices.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py sliding_windows: the start range was range(len(items) - size), dropping the last window. It is now range(len(items) - size + 1). python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 with exit 0, and no test files changed. Edge cases checked: empty input, size greater than len (empty result), size equal to len, size 1, and size 0 raising ValueError. pr.body: Approach: one-line bound fix in window.py. The start-index range now includes len(items) - size, so every window from index 0 through len(items) - size is produced. Inputs shorter than size still give an empty list because the range is empty. No test files changed. Checks: python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 (exit 0); edge-case asserts pass. Independent review passed at head 845a792 with no findings.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return the last window. now python3 -m unittest passes. before: range(len(items) - size) dropped the final window, now: range(len(items) - size + 1).
